design_notes: Use hairline rules and two rule weights; serif throughout; single accent colour for the pull-quote and table header.
The financials table should sit directly after the paragraph introducing the ₹ lakhs-to-₹ crore conversion, with the footnote line set in small caps.
The industry snapshot sits between the first and second paragraphs of the market section; keep the stat strip to three numbers and the growth bars proportional to value.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: Infrastructure here means power, bridges, dams, roads and urban infrastructure development, the physical build-out of the country
industry_snapshot.growth_bars_label: Logistics sector — forecast growth at 10.5% CAGR
industry_snapshot.rationale: The industry section is a wall of programme names and ten-year numbers; a stat strip and one growth bar make the scale and the near-term forecast legible without adding facts.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Two concentrations define the business, and they are the same concentration seen from two angles.
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway has been a client since 2006 and is the largest exposure, at 52% of orders on hand [^drhp-p67][^drhp-p65].
pull_quotes.rationale: A single counterparty carrying more than half the order book is the sharpest disclosed fact in the filing and the prose cannot make it land as hard as a pull-quote.

sidebars.body_markdown: The issue is 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value, at an issue price the filing leaves as ₹[●] [^drhp-p29]. The split between fresh issue and offer for sale is not stated in these excerpts, and no selling shareholder is named [^drhp-p29]. ₹1,130 lakhs (₹11.30 crore) is earmarked for working capital; general corporate purposes carries no disclosed amount [^drhp-p48]. Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited is lead manager and Bigshare Services Private Limited is registrar [^drhp-p31]. No monitoring agency has been appointed; the filing says proceeds are at management's discretion, monitored by the audit committee [^drhp-p18].
sidebars.rationale: Consolidates the offer mechanics and the blanks in the filing into one scannable block, so the reader can see exactly what is and is not disclosed.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: The filing reports in ₹ lakhs; every figure below is converted to ₹ crore by dividing by 100.
tables.rationale: The five-year divergence between falling revenue and rising earnings is the report's central puzzle; a table lets the reader see it at a glance.
tables.title: Five years of restated financials
